'''Dran's Peak''' was the tallest mountain within the [[Erkeere Ridge/Legends|Erkeere Ridge]] mountain range on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. Towering twice as high as its four neighboring peaks, Dran's was the site of a ritual often preformed by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] visiting the nearby [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] at [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]]. When the Empire held the planet, the Peak's slopes were used by [[Sith sorcerer]]s to focus their power.<ref name="NoP" />
